description: This file defines the TrustedAdvisorClient class within the AWS SDK for PHP, which interacts with the AWS Trusted Advisor Public API. The class primarily contains method signatures for various API calls related to AWS Trusted Advisor, including retrieval and update operations for recommendations and organizational data.

classes.name: TrustedAdvisorClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Trusted Advisor Public API via the AWS SDK for PHP.

methods.name: batchUpdateRecommendationResourceExclusion
methods.description: Sends a request to batch update resource exclusions for recommendations.

methods.name: getOrganizationRecommendation
methods.description: Retrieves recommendations specific to an organization.

methods.name: listChecks
methods.description: Lists all checks available in Trusted Advisor.

methods.name: listOrganizationRecommendationAccounts
methods.description: Lists accounts involved in organization recommendations.

methods.name: listOrganizationRecommendationResources
methods.description: Lists resources associated with organization recommendations.

methods.name: listRecommendationResources
methods.description: Lists resources related to specific recommendations.

methods.name: updateOrganizationRecommendationLifecycle
methods.description: Updates the lifecycle status of organization recommendations.
